text.name: ks_scope
text.tool_tip: These settings change how server lights and Viewer Lights are rendered for you; nothing is sent to the server.

slider.label: Max nearby lights
slider.name: ks_max_lights
slider.tool_tip: Counts nearby candidates, not only visible lights. Shared with Preferences and Viewer Lights.

check_box.label: Only Viewer Lights
check_box.name: ks_only_viewer_lights
check_box.tool_tip: Hides every server light; only Viewer Lights light the scene.

check_box.label: Subject sort
check_box.name: ks_subject_sort
check_box.tool_tip: Prioritize lights near the Alt-click focus. (KS Reference)

check_box.label: Alpha masks lit as opaque
check_box.name: ks_mask_deferred
check_box.tool_tip: Cut-out alpha (leaves, lace, hair tips) is drawn as opaque, so it gets every light, shadows and occlusion, and Viewer Lights spot cones. Applies to objects as they are rebuilt.

check_box.label: Fullbright alpha masks as opaque
check_box.name: ks_mask_fullbright
check_box.tool_tip: The same for fullbright faces, which are not lit by the deferred pass. Applies to objects as they are rebuilt.

check_box.label: Light bounding boxes
check_box.name: ks_light_boxes
check_box.tool_tip: Boxes around every light object: server lights, and Viewer Lights with the LLVOVolume backend (not the Shader backend).

check_box.label: Worn lights
check_box.name: ks_worn_lights
check_box.tool_tip: Lights in attachments, yours and other people's. Off hides them all in your view only; others still see them.

check_box.label: Show selected light radius
check_box.name: ks_light_radius
check_box.tool_tip: Draws the reach of the light in the object selected with the Build tools, while they are open.
